about: The eval test set (D72, 11 Oct; docs/evals/advanced.md). Each case is a typed line and goal run through the real pipeline on dev to chapter 1, scored on the rubric (convex/rubric.ts), three runs a case; a case passes only when all three runs reach every expected level and every code check holds. list 'keep' = passes today, one failure blocks a release (npm run eval:gate). list 'fix' = what we work on next; three passing runs in a row move it to 'keep'. Cases added from live misses on /admin are stored in the evalCases table on prod and merged in by the runner.
